game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round, winter bandits strike the frozen well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the base_case value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the frozen well from winter bandits in Firewood Stacks: keep the base_case meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: base_case drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 1 (intro tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while base_case > 0.
